thread:
maria_sec: Heads-up — we just got a security advisory sweep that flags multiple third-party libs in the inference stack: protobuf (CVE-2025-0421), sentencepiece (CVE-2025-1102), and a set of Triton/FlashAttention kernel patches that may affect vLLM-backed runtimes. Need quick triage and prioritization.

alex_runtime: Thanks — can you summarize severity and exploitability? Any PoCs?

maria_sec: protobuf looks like a parsing RCE when fed crafted serialized messages (high). sentencepiece is a buffer overflow in model tokenization step (high/medium depending on input sanitization). Triton/Flash kernels are a privilege escalation in custom CUDA kernels (medium) — vendor patches available but require driver/kernel compatibility checks. No public PoC yet for Triton.

jon_enginfra: Ops note: Triton patches require testing across our Dedicated GPU fleet (A100 v5 vs A100 v4), plus a driver update path. We should avoid mass reboots during business hours.

sara_ml: For vLLM-based endpoints: we can pin to a CPU-tokenizer-safe fallback for sentencepiece affected models, but that will increase latency. Suggest canary these changes on staging.

ops-bot: New ticket created: INF-2025-47 (triage/proto) assigned to @maria_sec and @alex_runtime. Priority: P0 -> P1 after initial assessment.

maria_sec: Proposed priority order: 1) protobuf (RCE) 2) sentencepiece (tokenizer overflow) 3) Triton/Flash kernels (priv esc). Also assessing transitive deps in our build images.

lee_sre: Rollout plan idea: patch protobuf everywhere first in a fast window (nonblocking configs + canary). For model-serving pods, enable immediate request dropping on suspicious serialized payloads using a strict proto schema validator as mitigation.

alex_runtime: Agree. Mitigations we can deploy quickly:
```
# enforce protobuf schema validation in ingress
pip install protobuf-validator
# example config snippet
ingress:
  proto_validation: strict
```
Also for sentencepiece, we can temporarily set the tokenizer to use the hermetic wheel we build: `sentencepiece==0.1.98-redwood1` until upstream publishes.

jon_enginfra: We need RBAC & audit changes for patch ops: create a short-lived role `patcher/inference-runtime` with just the rights to deploy to Dedicated pools and pull images. All actions logged to our audit log (stackdriver -> longterm retention). @eva_privacy can you confirm retention/visibility requirements?

eva_privacy: Need logs to be retained 1 year for these events and keyed to customer IDs for any access. Also KMS rotation: ensure new artifact signing keys are in KMS and access requires two-person approval for production deploys.

maria_sec: KMS integration question: when we sign the patched runtime images, do we use per-cluster keys or a single org key? Per-cluster reduces blast radius but increases key management ops. Thoughts?

alex_runtime: Prefer per-cluster keys for Dedicated and Private customers. Hosted API can use org key with stricter RBAC. We'll automate key creation in infra repo (`infra/scripts/kms-rotate.sh`).

lee_sre: For rollback safety, implement model fallback routing: if a runtime instance fails health checks after patch, route to older model variant hosted in a sandboxed pool (no access to new KV caches). Adds cost but safer.

sara_ml: Test matrix I propose: unit tokenizer fuzzing, integration model decode tests, Triton kernel smoke on A100v4/v5, and end-to-end latency regression. I'll open eval jobs.

maria_sec: Timeline suggestion: today - triage & mitigations; tomorrow morning - canary protobuf patch on staging; 48 hours - sentencepiece pinned on safe wheel; 72-96 hours - Triton kernel rollout with driver team.

jon_enginfra: Scheduling note: we need a maintenance window for Triton driver upgrades. Please coordinate with platform calendar.

alex_runtime: I'll prepare a deploy playbook and a `rollback.sh` that flips routing to fallback pool and reverts image tag. Example snippet:
```
# rollback.sh (very simplified)
kubectl set image deploy/model-serving model=image:previous
kubectl rollout status deploy/model-serving
```

maria_sec: QA checklist for security sign-off: CVE IDs tracked, reproducer attempts documented, mitigations in place, RBAC role created, KMS keys provisioned, audit logging enabled, rollback verified. Mark me when done and I'll sign off.

eva_privacy: Also ensure customer notification templates are drafted in case any tenant data exposure is suspected. Legal wants the wording ready.

ops-bot: INF-2025-47 status updated -> IN_PROGRESS.

lee_sre: Quick question: do we throttle canary traffic to 1%? :thinking_face:

alex_runtime: Yes, 1% for protobuf patch canary. For sentencepiece fallback, 0.5% initially.

maria_sec: Thanks everyone. I'll compile this into the INF-2025-47 ticket with owners and target dates. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
